overview_description.description:
360Learning is the AI-powered learning platform that combines LMS and LXP capabilities to drive onboarding, employee development, and customer training at scale. L&D teams—from solo practitioners to global enterprises—use 360Learning to turn internal expertise into collaborative, skills-based learning for employees, customers, and partners. 360Learning’s collaborative learning approach, combined with deep integrations with systems like SAP and Workday, empowers organizations to upskill at scale through expert-led communities of practice around key topics, roles, and more.

Over 2,500 companies including Safran, Cognizant, Bally’s Corporation, Duolingo, and Smile Brands, trust 360Learning to power learning at work. Since 2013, the company has raised $240 million and built a global team across North America and Europe. 360Learning pioneered collaborative learning, launched the first AI certification for L&D, and founded the L&D Collective to connect learning leaders worldwide.
